intro: Converting ounces (oz) to pounds (lb) is essential when translating measurements across international freight shipping, gym barbell loading, laboratory formulation, and commercial food packaging. One ounce equals 0.0625 pounds, while one pound equals 16 ounces. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Short Ton, Long Ton, Metric Tonne & Troy vs. Avoirdupois Weight
items: In the United States, "ton" without qualification refers to the US short ton (2,000 lb = 907.18474 kg), whereas the metric tonne equals 1,000 kg (2,204.62 lb) and the UK long ton equals 2,240 lb (1,016.05 kg).
Everyday weight conversions use the Avoirdupois ounce (28.349523125 g) and pound (16 oz = 453.59237 g); precious metals like gold and silver use the heavier Troy ounce (31.1034768 g).

formula.standardNote: Verified against NIST SP 811 and BIPM SI Brochure (1 oz = 0.0625 lb).

faqs.question: How many pounds are in 1 ounce?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0625 pounds (lb) in 1 ounce (oz). To convert oz to lb, use the exact conversion factor 0.0625.

faqs.question: How do I convert ounces to pounds manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your ounce value by 0.0625 (exact factor: 0.0625). For example, 10 oz × 0.0625 = 0.625 lb.
